In Xcode, select File > Add Package Dependencies…
Click Add Local… and choose <PROJECT_ROOT>/DebugTools/ap-ios-debug-kit.
Add the APIOSDebugKit product only to a dedicated Debug app target; keep every Release or production target free of this package dependency.
Add <PROJECT_ROOT>/DebugTools/APIOSDebugBootstrap.swift only to the dedicated Debug app target, call try await APIOSDebugBootstrap.start() at Debug startup, and call await APIOSDebugBootstrap.stop() later at shutdown.
